answer: Proof of Burn mechanisms provide robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to permanently destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Much like a sonnet requires strict structure to hold meaning, this economic barrier prevents an attacker from bridging the vast canyon between cost and reward. Without this immutable sable ledger to anchor identity, an attacker could proliferate infinite identities, yet the burnt capital ensures that every malicious node incurs a non-recoverable financial loss.
